bara_imambara.name: Bara Imambara & Bhulbhulaiya
bara_imambara.description: Monumental 1784 complex built by Nawab Asaf-ud-Daula featuring the world's largest arched hall unsupported by beams and the famed labyrinth (Bhulbhulaiya).
bara_imambara.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Hire a guide for the labyrinth)

chhota_imambara.name: Chhota Imambara (Palace of Lights)
chhota_imambara.description: Exquisite 1838 monument built by Muhammad Ali Shah, celebrated for its golden dome, Belgian crystal chandeliers, Quranic calligraphy, and festive illuminations.

rumi_darwaza.name: Rumi Darwaza (Turkish Gate)
rumi_darwaza.description: Soaring 60-foot ornamental gate built in 1784 modeled after the Sublime Porte of Istanbul, standing as the quintessential visual symbol of Awadhi grandeur.
rumi_darwaza.best_time_to_visit: Evening when illuminated against the night sky

the_residency_lucknow.name: The British Residency & Memorial
the_residency_lucknow.description: Historical complex of picturesque brick ruins preserved exactly as left after the fierce 1857 Siege of Lucknow, featuring bullet-scarred walls and museum.

ambedkar_memorial_park.name: Ambedkar Memorial Park
ambedkar_memorial_park.description: Monumental 107-acre civic memorial built of pink Rajasthan sandstone, famed for 62 sculpted stone elephants, grand stupas, and cinematic night lighting.

janeshwar_mishra_park.name: Janeshwar Mishra Park
janeshwar_mishra_park.description: Asia's largest urban eco-park spanning 376 green acres in Gomti Nagar, featuring expansive boating lakes, cycling tracks, and lush floral grounds.

hazratganj_market.name: Hazratganj Heritage Boulevard
hazratganj_market.description: The historic shopping promenade of Lucknow revamped in uniform Victorian-cream facades, home to iconic chikankari showrooms, bookstores, and basket chaat.

hussainabad_clock_tower.name: Hussainabad Clock Tower (Ghanta Ghar)
hussainabad_clock_tower.description: India's tallest clock tower rising 221 feet, constructed in 1881 with Victorian-Gothic elegance to mark the arrival of Sir George Couper.
hussainabad_clock_tower.best_time_to_visit: Evening when illuminated alongside the Hussainabad pond

lucknow_zoo.name: Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Zoological Garden (Lucknow Zoo)
lucknow_zoo.description: Historic 71-acre zoological sanctuary established in 1921, housing royal Bengal tigers, white tigers, Asiatic lions, vintage toy train rides, and State Museum.

dilkusha_kothi.name: Dilkusha Kothi & Hunting Lodge
dilkusha_kothi.description: Atmospheric 1800 English Baroque hunting lodge ruins built by Nawab Saadat Ali Khan, surrounded by serene manicured lawns in Lucknow Cantonment.

chattar_manzil.name: Chattar Manzil (Umbrella Palace)
chattar_manzil.description: Striking Indo-European palace on the banks of Gomti River, distinguished by its gilded umbrella-shaped dome (chattar) and subterranean typhoons.

constantia_la_martiniere.name: Constantia (La Martiniere College Campus)
constantia_la_martiniere.description: Architectural marvel combining Italian, French, and Gothic styles built by Major General Claude Martin in 1795, famed for lions, gargoyles, and lakes.

jama_masjid_lucknow.name: Jama Masjid Hussainabad
jama_masjid_lucknow.description: Grand 19th-century mosque built entirely of yellow sandstone, elevated on a high plinth with 260 carved pillars and 15 arched entryways.

picture_gallery_hussainabad.name: Hussainabad Picture Gallery
picture_gallery_hussainabad.description: 19th-century royal portrait gallery overlooking a stepped pond, famed for life-sized oil paintings of Awadh nawabs painted with optical-illusion perspective.

gomti_riverfront_park.name: Gomti Riverfront Promenade
gomti_riverfront_park.description: Vibrant landscaped waterfront along the Gomti River featuring pedestrian boulevards, illuminated fountains, cycling tracks, and sunset views.

ram_manohar_lohia_park.name: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Park
ram_manohar_lohia_park.description: Tranquil 76-acre community park in Gomti Nagar designed with walking paths, an artificial lake, musical fountains, and extensive herbal gardens.

kudia_ghat.name: Kudia Ghat (Old Gomti Ghat)
kudia_ghat.description: Historic stone ghat on the Gomti River close to the heritage zone, offering boat rides, heritage streetlamps, and tranquil dawn reflection.

regional_science_city_lucknow.name: Regional Science City (Aliganj)
regional_science_city_lucknow.description: Engaging interactive science museum featuring biotechnology galleries, 3D science movies, space exploration exhibits, and an outdoor dinosaur science park.

indira_gandhi_planetarium.name: Indira Gandhi Planetarium
indira_gandhi_planetarium.description: Uniquely designed planetarium building shaped like the planet Saturn with five outer rings, screening high-tech cosmic shows and space exploration films.

kaiserbagh_palace_complex.name: Kaiserbagh Palace & Safed Baradari
kaiserbagh_palace_complex.description: Ruins of the theatrical quadrangle palace constructed by Nawab Wajid Ali Shah in 1850, crowned by the elegant white stone pavilion 'Safed Baradari'.

mankameshwar_temple.name: Mankameshwar Mandir
mankameshwar_temple.description: Revered 1,000-year-old Shiva shrine on the banks of Gomti, where according to legend Lakshmana stopped to pray after escorting Sita.

chandrika_devi_temple.name: Chandrika Devi Temple (Kathwara)
chandrika_devi_temple.description: Ancient pilgrimage shrine dedicated to Goddess Chandrika situated beside a sacred water pond on the Gomti outskirts, steeped in Mahabharata legend.

charbagh_railway_station.name: Charbagh Railway Station (Heritage Architecture)
charbagh_railway_station.description: One of India's most breathtaking railway stations built in 1914; its Mughal-Rajput domed towers resemble a giant chessboard with pieces when viewed from above.

chowk_lucknow.name: Chowk Old City Heritage Bazaar
chowk_lucknow.description: Heart of Old Lucknow famed for narrow alleys, wholesale Chikankari ateliers, traditional ittar (perfume) shops, and legendary 1905 Tunday Kababi.

aminabad_bazaar.name: Aminabad Traditional Market
aminabad_bazaar.description: Historic trade square operating since Nawabi times, packed with bridalwear, chikan suits, and iconic dining spots like Prakash Kulfi and Wahid Biryani.

satkhanda.name: Satkhanda (Unfinished Seven-Story Watchtower)
satkhanda.description: Graceful red-brick watchtower commissioned by King Muhammad Ali Shah in 1840; planned for 7 stories to observe the moon but halted at 4 upon his death.

shah_najaf_imambara.name: Shah Najaf Imambara
shah_najaf_imambara.description: Pure white domed mausoleum on the Gomti River built in 1817 by Ghazi-ud-Din Haidar, modeled after the shrine of Hazrat Ali in Najaf, Iraq.

sikandar_bagh.name: Sikandar Bagh & NBRI Garden
sikandar_bagh.description: Enclosed garden villa built by Nawab Wajid Ali Shah for Queen Sikandar Mahal, pivotal in the 1857 uprising; now part of the National Botanical Research Institute.

state_museum_lucknow.name: State Museum Lucknow
state_museum_lucknow.description: Uttar Pradesh's premier museum inside the zoo campus housing an authentic 1000 BCE Egyptian mummy, 1st-century Mathura sculptures, and Awadhi bronzes.

shahi_baoli.name: Shahi Baoli (Royal Stepwell)
shahi_baoli.description: Ingenious 18th-century stepwell within Bara Imambara compound with an angled mirror-water design that allowed guards to see intruders without being seen.

nawabganj_bird_sanctuary.name: Shahid Chandra Shekhar Azad Bird Sanctuary (Nawabganj)
nawabganj_bird_sanctuary.description: Vast wetland bird reserve along the Lucknow-Kanpur highway hosting over 250 species of migratory waterfowl including Siberian cranes, pintails, and flamingos.

kgmu_heritage_campus.name: King George's Medical University Campus
kgmu_heritage_campus.description: Grand Indo-Saracenic medical campus founded in 1905 overlooking the Gomti, crowned with distinctive yellow stone minarets, clock towers, and courtyards.

butler_palace.name: Butler Palace & Lake
butler_palace.description: Sole Rajasthani-style four-storied palace in Lucknow built in 1919 by the Raja of Mahmudabad beside a tranquil tank, featuring chhatris and ornate jharokhas.

begum_hazrat_mahal_park.name: Begum Hazrat Mahal Park
begum_hazrat_mahal_park.description: Serene landscaped city garden honoring the courageous Queen of Awadh who led the 1857 uprising, marked by an ornate white marble memorial.

kukrail_reserve_forest.name: Kukrail Gharial Sanctuary & Reserve Forest
kukrail_reserve_forest.description: World-renowned freshwater crocodile and endangered gharial conservation breeding sanctuary set within a dense deer forest ideal for eco-picnics.

phoenix_palassio.name: Phoenix Palassio Mega Mall
phoenix_palassio.description: Uttar Pradesh's most opulent shopping destination, designed like a grand neoclassical European palace with 200+ crystal chandeliers and INOX Megaplex.

lulu_mall_lucknow.name: LuLu Mall Lucknow
lulu_mall_lucknow.description: One of North India's largest mega-malls sprawling over 2.2 million square feet on Amar Shaheed Path, featuring the colossal LuLu Hypermarket and Funtura amusement.

ekana_cricket_stadium.name: BRSABV Ekana International Cricket Stadium
ekana_cricket_stadium.description: World-class 50,000-seater international cricket arena, home ground of Lucknow Super Giants (IPL) and host of Cricket World Cup fixtures.

hanuman_setu_temple.name: Hanuman Setu Temple
hanuman_setu_temple.description: Deeply revered Hanuman temple by the Lucknow University Gomti bridge, established by the mystic saint Neem Karoli Baba in the 1960s.

aliganj_purana_hanuman_mandir.name: Purana Hanuman Mandir (Aliganj)
aliganj_purana_hanuman_mandir.description: Symbol of Awadh's Ganga-Jamuni tehzeeb, built by Begum Jan-e-Aliya (wife of Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula) bearing a crescent on its spire; origin of Lucknow's Bada Mangal festival.

dargah_hazrat_abbas.name: Dargah Hazrat Abbas (Rustam Nagar)
dargah_hazrat_abbas.description: Historic Shia shrine in Rustam Nagar housing the consecrated battle standard (Alam) of Hazrat Abbas, drawing devotees seeking healing and blessings.

buddha_shanti_upvan.name: Gautam Buddha Park & Water Canal
buddha_shanti_upvan.description: Lush family park between Rumi Darwaza and the Science City featuring an impressive seated Buddha statue, canal pedal boating, and play equipment.

bhootnath_market.name: Bhootnath Traditional Market & Temple
bhootnath_market.description: Major trans-Gomti retail market centered around the sacred Bhootnath Shiva temple in Indira Nagar, vibrant with sweets, jewelry, and ethnic clothes.

suraj_kund_lucknow.name: Suraj Kund Heritage Tank
suraj_kund_lucknow.description: Ancient sun-worship stepped tank in Raja Bazaar believed to have been renovated by Mughal finance minister Raja Todar Mal.

anandi_water_park.name: Anandi Water Park & Resort
anandi_water_park.description: Northern India's premier aquatic resort on Faizabad Road, boasting 32 waterslides, giant wave pool, lazy river, and rain dance floors.

manyavar_kanshi_ram_eco_park.name: Manyavar Kanshi Ram Smriti Upvan (Eco Park)
manyavar_kanshi_ram_eco_park.description: Expansive 112-acre green reserve on VIP Road filled with bronze animal statues, illuminated walkways, fountains, and picnic lawns.

residency_cemetery.name: Residency Memorial Cemetery & St. Mary's Church
residency_cemetery.description: Solemn historic churchyard containing the grave of Sir Henry Lawrence with his famous self-composed epitaph, alongside 2,000 siege defenders.

alambagh_palace.name: Alambagh Palace & Kothi
alambagh_palace.description: Nawabi garden retreat built for Begum Alam Ara in 1840, later serving as an armed British military outpost during the relief of Lucknow in 1857.

kalyangiri_temple.name: Kalyangiri Shiva Mandir (Daliganj)
kalyangiri_temple.description: Centuries-old riverside Shiva sanctum in Daliganj adorned with intricate stone shikhara, holding great spiritual significance for local devotees.

marine_drive_lucknow.name: Marine Drive Promenade (Gomti Nagar)
marine_drive_lucknow.description: Scenic road boulevard running along the Gomti River opposite Ambedkar Park, famed as Lucknow's favorite youth hangout for late night drives and river breezes.
